For clinical or toxic alcohol serum estimates based on volume and percentage ingested, you can also use the Estimated Ethanol (and Toxic Alcohol) Serum Concentration Based on Ingestion Calculator.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXE4AW5s980WnL69nnut7tpFysrEQDxidaf6DFCt_MI3ONyk9eRY_lhln-xkx7PBmKoAwTP4jAEn7eOO4fUhUKat2da5d78QoL7Nwl5gFT6-aNEXq9dn6BYLNXBLcMQMVX64IE6I_6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF16jEcVHbJ733plb6BYy8yYDdgdGrLeQiJUV3U2VOT_CXT9dMwnIOc0eMAnrJeQJRhAjUOxj9piTvdlt70JIqAkHcaHv5U8-6IbrrSQ9W9UuhlLbZ7lmnC7rLDD3Bc1C9xk0UUu9SXGwAjLaeTjOWEKu6SF18AlhPbQl9WxXTjqayBS6jJTGgfmX2TqWwfJdW2h8iAD0uyIttDXXLWw)

### How Alcohol Metabolism Works

- **Elimination rate:** On average, the body eliminates alcohol at about **0.015% to 0.016% BAC per hour** , roughly equal to **one standard drink per hour**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXZWLmX5Vq0LDhWPJqPdVMJ_EodbtVtCje4H-EybtURvhRj6zJS1HkpL98h2JeDvF9J2njcrrlvnFxjfjA-tGGKO5RI_rz_jF6fQ1oCDXB8u1oWY8Ykhr3sjVNPyuyUNqnsd0gyl3_z5pbsvmDjmox9g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXbQTB39guPSYpWqQThb6yEi8xJ8oZmzNusitfjn7BI2UkiuZsigavQvkgnXfk7dq5g42p5cbkYMB8_WHvW4YFTFg7_PgCbGhpvTC8-9CLtOycXNpi8p2HEmuEoA4LyIbj0532Fczg6SskWho)
- **Absorption timing:** Alcohol typically takes **30 to 70 minutes** after drinking to reach peak levels in the bloodstream.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXZWLmX5Vq0LDhWPJqPdVMJ_EodbtVtCje4H-EybtURvhRj6zJS1HkpL98h2JeDvF9J2njcrrlvnFxjfjA-tGGKO5RI_rz_jF6fQ1oCDXB8u1oWY8Ykhr3sjVNPyuyUNqnsd0gyl3_z5pbsvmDjmox9g)
- **No shortcuts:** Coffee, cold showers, food, or extra water do not speed up liver metabolism; only time lowers BAC.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXz293thmo0mqO9QuBQ_eRlKGNGd7NmreQKKWB32Eg15ngwZL8NindWymSdoZaW3JBNp0IM-0TryZHew4yboVYotLaL2ECm4NlLBnKDpBVRLyoDQyLMNY2Z518JA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXbQTB39guPSYpWqQThb6yEi8xJ8oZmzNusitfjn7BI2UkiuZsigavQvkgnXfk7dq5g42p5cbkYMB8_WHvW4YFTFg7_PgCbGhpvTC8-9CLtOycXNpi8p2HEmuEoA4LyIbj0532Fczg6SskWho)
- **Estimates only:** Calculators rely on averages and do not account for individual differences like food intake, liver health, medications, or tolerance. Do not use a calculator to judge whether you are safe to drive.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF19G8ZV-kIES5YrwG1jvCPOlu78BYFS7kdY4sMOtA1jNmmK3RcgB4KTU7VYNe64TsfrHhwxDFwZljTsM08iyrifEzzshf3NGCCSooC7_RHXqFzCHuNij-FNuKJhhksdZET8Z7CzIpwj1NIO9zbfUOnKhLGTec3NM2mtDAO_bn1plW8xAKTKE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXz293thmo0mqO9QuBQ_eRlKGNGd7NmreQKKWB32Eg15ngwZL8NindWymSdoZaW3JBNp0IM-0TryZHew4yboVYotLaL2ECm4NlLBnKDpBVRLyoDQyLMNY2Z518JA)

### Standard Drink Equivalents (U.S.)
One U.S. standard drink contains about **14 grams (0.6 fl oz)** of pure alcohol:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXE4gWuoBMSkL24-5Mu5o1RqiRleDVtQUebARsFBxdBLmpZrZ5AXsLI1f1LHtXuUqJkRF9NLl07FK62YNfJH1CLZ6oHnP8Mh3vepCIXGmICMwHNKHAsuYl2sbaHyOgYNJOqkcpXyxwBD1BsE3ikVDfgYTwhGVhmts7gw)

- **Beer:** 12 fl oz at ~5% ABV
- **Table wine:** 5 fl oz at ~12% ABV
- **Distilled spirits:** 1.5 fl oz shot at 40% ABV (80 proof)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXE4gWuoBMSkL24-5Mu5o1RqiRleDVtQUebARsFBxdBLmpZrZ5AXsLI1f1LHtXuUqJkRF9NLl07FK62YNfJH1CLZ6oHnP8Mh3vepCIXGmICMwHNKHAsuYl2sbaHyOgYNJOqkcpXyxwBD1BsE3ikVDfgYTwhGVhmts7gw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXZWLmX5Vq0LDhWPJqPdVMJ_EodbtVtCje4H-EybtURvhRj6zJS1HkpL98h2JeDvF9J2njcrrlvnFxjfjA-tGGKO5RI_rz_jF6fQ1oCDXB8u1oWY8Ykhr3sjVNPyuyUNqnsd0gyl3_z5pbsvmDjmox9g)
